summary.headline: Remaining Accidents of Fortune
summary.text: Chapter 50 explains the remaining effects of the Part of Fortune: its placement in the exaltations, houses, or terms of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Mercury, and the Moon determines fortunate associations with corresponding social groups. It also describes the Part of Fortune in angles, succedent and cadent houses, and its favorable aspect with the Sun.
